Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.1: Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Appreciate the teachings of the Hadith in nurturing the piousness of a Muslim. facilitate memorization. Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and Collaboration Critical Thinking and Problem Solving

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Appreciate the teachings of the Hadith in nurturing the piousness of a Muslim. facilitate memorization. Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and Collaboration Critical Thinking and Problem Solving
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the teachings of the Hadith in nurturing the piousness of a Muslim. facilitate memorization. Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and Collaboration Critical Thinking and Problem Solving. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of.
2. Explain Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of.
4. Show that you can: Appreciate the teachings of the Hadith in nurturing the piousness of a Muslim. facilitate memorization. Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and Collaboration Critical Thinking and Problem Solving
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Appreciate the teachings of the Hadith in nurturing the piousness of a Muslim. facilitate memorization. Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and Collaboration Critical Thinking and Problem Solving
